questions.stem:
—I can't find my keys. ______ you ______ them?
—Yes. I put them on the desk just now.
questions.explanation: 考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。问句强调'到现在为止你是否见过钥匙'，是对现在造成的影响（钥匙现在不见了），应用现在完成时'Have you seen'；答句中'just now'（刚才）是明确的过去时间状语，应用一般过去时'put'。A选项Did see只强调过去动作，不体现与现在的联系；C是一般现在时，不符合语境；D是将来时，明显错误。解题技巧：看到'just now'用过去时，强调'过去动作对现在影响'用现在完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ cover is red belongs to my sister.
questions.explanation: 考查定语从句关系词的选择。先行词是'the book'，定语从句中'cover'（封面）与先行词是所属关系（书的面），应用whose表示'……的'。A选项who指人；B选项which在从句中作主语或宾语；D选项that不能表示所属关系。解题技巧：空格后有名词，且表示所属关系（……的），选whose。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The broken bike ______ by my father tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 考查一般将来时的被动语态。主语'the broken bike'是动作'repair'的承受者，应用被动语态；时间状语'tomorrow'表明是将来时，所以用'will be repaired'。A是现在时被动；B是过去时被动；C是主动语态，且bike不能自己修理自己。解题技巧：看到tomorrow用将来时，主语是物且是动作承受者用被动，结构为will be done。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Could you tell me ______?
—Sure. Next Friday afternoon.
options: A. when we will have the meeting
B. when will we have the meeting
C. when we had the meeting
D. when did we have the meeting
questions.explanation: 考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句必须用陈述句语序（主语+谓语），排除B和D；根据答句'Next Friday afternoon'（下周五下午）可知是将来时，排除C（过去时）。解题技巧：宾语从句三要素——陈述语序、时态呼应（主现从随便，主过从必过）、连接词选择。答句是将来时间，所以用will have。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: It's ______ to play with fire. We must stay away from it.
questions.explanation: 考查形容词词义辨析。根据常识和后半句'stay away from it'（远离它）可知玩火是'dangerous'（危险的）。B选项safe（安全的）与句意相反；C选项exciting（令人兴奋的）和D选项boring（无聊的）不符合语境。解题技巧：根据上下文逻辑和常识判断，'stay away'提示负面情绪或危险。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The ______ news made all of us very happy.
questions.explanation: 考查词性转换和形容词辨析。空格修饰名词'news'（物），需要形容词。pleasant表示'令人愉快的'，常修饰物；pleased表示'感到高兴的'，常修饰人；please是动词；pleasing虽可修饰物，但pleasant更常用且符合此语境。解题技巧：-ing形容词修饰物（令人……的），-ed形容词修饰人（感到……的）。news是物，选pleasant。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Please ______ the TV when you go to bed. Don't waste electricity.
questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。turn on打开，turn off关闭，turn up调大（音量），turn down调小（音量）/拒绝。根据'go to bed'（睡觉）和'Don't waste electricity'（不要浪费电）可知要'关掉'电视。解题技巧：根据语境逻辑，睡前为了省电应该关闭电器，而不是打开或调节音量。

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a green project called "Zero Waste Classroom". The goal was to reduce waste and protect the environment. As members of the Environmental Club, my classmates and I were excited to take part in it.

At first, we found it (8)______ to change our habits. Many students used to throw away plastic bottles and paper casually. To solve this problem, we placed recycling bins in every classroom. We also made posters to remind everyone to sort their waste properly.

The most challenging part was convincing some stubborn students. They didn't understand why they had to spend extra time sorting garbage. We didn't give up. Instead, we organized a presentation showing how plastic pollution harms sea animals. After watching the video, many students changed their (9)______. They started bringing reusable water bottles and using both sides of paper.

By the end of the semester, we had achieved amazing results. The amount of daily waste dropped by 60%. Our principal was so impressed that he decided to (10)______ the project to the whole school next term. He praised our team for making such a great difference.

This experience taught me that small actions can lead to big changes. Although it required patience and hard work, seeing the cleaner campus made it all worthwhile. I am proud that we (11)______ something positive for our planet. Environmental protection is not just a slogan; it requires everyone's (12)______.
questions.explanation: 考查语境推理。根据下文'Many students used to throw away plastic bottles and paper casually'（许多学生过去常随意扔掉塑料瓶和纸）以及'To solve this problem'（为了解决这个问题）可知，起初改变习惯是'困难的'。A选项easy（容易的）与语境相反；C选项possible（可能的）和D选项necessary（必要的）不符合上下文逻辑。解题技巧：通过下文描述的问题严重性推断出改变的难度。

questions.stem: According to the passage, why do many teenagers have sleep problems?
options: A. They have too much homework.
B. They use electronic devices before sleep.
D. They drink too much coffee.
questions.group_passage:
Sleep is one of the most important parts of our daily life, but many teenagers don't get enough of it. Studies show that adolescents need about 8-10 hours of sleep per night to stay healthy and perform well at school.

However, modern lifestyles often prevent students from sleeping enough. The blue light from smartphones and computers can trick the brain into thinking it is still daytime. This suppresses (抑制) the production of melatonin, a hormone that makes us feel sleepy. As a result, many students find it hard to fall asleep even when they feel tired.

Lack of sleep affects both physical and mental health. Tired students usually have trouble concentrating in class and remembering new information. They are also more likely to feel stressed or irritated (易怒的). In the long term, chronic sleep deprivation can weaken the immune system and increase the risk of obesity.

To solve this problem, experts suggest creating a regular sleep schedule. Going to bed and waking up at the same time every day helps regulate your body clock. It is also helpful to keep electronic devices out of the bedroom at least one hour before bedtime. Instead of scrolling through social media, try reading a book or listening to calm music.

Remember, sacrificing sleep time to study often backfires. A well-rested brain learns much faster than an exhausted one. By prioritizing sleep, you are actually investing in your academic success and overall well-being.
questions.explanation: 考查细节理解。根据第二段'The blue light from smartphones and computers can trick the brain...'（智能手机和电脑发出的蓝光会欺骗大脑……）可知，睡前使用电子设备导致睡眠问题。A选项作业太多、C选项不喜欢睡觉、D选项喝太多咖啡文中均未提及。解题技巧：定位关键词'sleep problems'，在第二段找到对应原因'blue light from smartphones and computers'。

(17)______ First, write down all your assignments and their deadlines. This helps you see clearly what needs to be done urgently. Use a planner or a digital app to organize your tasks.

questions.explanation: 考查逻辑关系。上文说'为爱好安排专门时间很重要'，下文说'要像对待课程一样认真对待这段时间'，中间需要转折提醒'但要确保不与重要截止日期冲突'。A选项However表示转折，提醒注意平衡。B、C、D已用或不符合；E与主题相反。解题技巧：根据However的转折逻辑，承认爱好的重要性同时提醒不要影响学业截止日期。

questions.group_passage:
Many students struggle to balance their schoolwork with hobbies. Here are some tips to help you manage your time better.

(17)______ First, write down all your assignments and their deadlines. This helps you see clearly what needs to be done urgently. Use a planner or a digital app to organize your tasks.

(18)______ Not all homework requires the same amount of time. Focus on difficult subjects when your mind is fresh, usually in the morning or early evening. Save easier tasks for when you feel tired.

It is also important to schedule specific time for your hobbies. (19)______ Treat this time as seriously as you would treat a class. If you love painting, set aside Saturday afternoon for it. This way, you won't feel guilty about taking breaks because they are planned.

(20)______ Remember that it's okay to say no to extra activities when you're already busy. Quality matters more than quantity. By following these suggestions, you can enjoy both good grades and personal interests.
questions.explanation: 考查总结归纳。空格位于最后一段开头，后文讲'记住当你很忙时可以说不'，这是总结性建议。C选项'As a result, you will become more productive and less stressed'（结果，你会变得更高效且压力更小）作为遵循上述建议后的结果/总结最合适。A、B、D已用；E与主题相反。解题技巧：最后一段通常总结或说明结果，'As a result'（结果是）符合总结逻辑。
